//: IIS deployment settings. web.config sets ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production, so this file overrides appsettings.json when the site runs under IIS. appsettings.json keeps the developer's local values and is not touched.
//ConnectionStrings: Replace SERVERNAME with the SQL instance that holds the SqlEstatePortal database. Trusted_Connection means the IIS application pool identity is what connects - that account needs db_owner on this database, because the portal creates and alters its own schema at startup.
//Assessment: ScriptPath and WorkingDirectory must both point INSIDE the published folder. The csproj copies Assess-SqlEstate.ps1 to the output on every publish, so the published copy is always current - a path pointing anywhere else will silently run an older script. Replace the path below with wherever you copied the publish output on the web server.
//Logging: Information is useful while bedding the deployment in - it shows the startup schema work and the severity re-rank. Drop Default to Warning once it is stable.
//AllowedHosts: Set this to the hostname the site is served on once you know it, rather than leaving the wildcard.
